card.name: Feedback and endocrine regulation terms
card.fires_on: The word "feedback" (also "compens" in compensatory and "uff" in insufficiency) in hormone and enzyme regulation text, such as pituitary-thyroid feedback or ALAS1 induction.

modes.label: Feedback mechanism
modes.description: The word feedback describing hormonal or enzyme regulation loops.
modes.example: induction of ALAS1 through a<< feedback>> mechanism.

modes.description: Part of a longer word about compensation or insufficiency of a body system.
